subject.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget

question: Should OpenClaw accept PR #96230's nested cumulative main-session restart-recovery fuse and tombstone behavior as the canonical fix for issue #95750?
rationale: The patch changes persisted session recovery semantics and availability behavior, and there is another open candidate PR for the same incident family, so automation should not decide the product contract.

options.title: Accept PR #96230 as canonical
options.body: Land the nested durable fuse/tombstone contract after normal CI and redirect PR #96083 as superseded.

options.title: Require a different recovery contract
options.body: Ask for changes such as a flat counter, different budget, or time-window semantics before merge.

options.title: Pause both candidate PRs
options.body: Keep both PRs open until the recovery owner chooses the long-term main-session and subagent policy together.

recommendation.title: Accept PR #96230 as canonical
recommendation.body: Land the nested durable fuse/tombstone contract after normal CI and redirect PR #96083 as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and already shaped the durable recovery-fuse semantics under review.
